note: MacLeod introduces Midnight Tale with a story told in company. This mountain picnic gives that sociable premise a place to sit, while the actual painted gathering keeps its own history.

zh-CN.title: 山间野餐
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Picnic in the Mountains; Single Page Illustration》的年代标为约1550–1600年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Midnight Tale》的上传日期列为2019-04-05，配器列为吉他、鲁特琴。
zh-CN.note: MacLeod介绍《Midnight Tale》时，写到了围坐讲故事的场面。山间野餐为这份相聚的心情找到了坐下的地方，画中的聚会也保有自己的故事。

title: Learning in a Pavilion
originalTitle: Garden Scene with a Master Instructing a Student in a Pavilion × Midnight Tale

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Garden Scene with a Master Instructing a Student in a Pavilion with the date c. 1570–1590s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Midnight Tale with an upload date of 2019-04-05 and the instrumentation Guitar, Lute.

note: A master and student make learning visible as time spent together. Midnight Tale brings the idea of telling and listening alongside that relationship, good company for reading a difficult chapter.

zh-CN.title: 亭中的一课
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Garden Scene with a Master Instructing a Student in a Pavilion》的年代标为约1570至1590年代。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Midnight Tale》的上传日期列为2019-04-05，配器列为吉他、鲁特琴。
zh-CN.note: 老师和学生让学习显出了一起度过时间的样子。《Midnight Tale》带来讲述与倾听的联想，适合陪着读一章需要慢慢消化的书。

title: Visiting an Old Friend
originalTitle: Visiting an Old Friend in the Spring Mountains × Midnight Tale

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Visiting an Old Friend in the Spring Mountains with the date 1300s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Midnight Tale with an upload date of 2019-04-05 and the instrumentation Guitar, Lute.

note: A visit already contains a story: someone has made the journey, someone is waiting. Midnight Tale adds its title's invitation to remain a little longer with this mountain meeting.

zh-CN.title: 访旧友
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Visiting an Old Friend in the Spring Mountains》的年代标为十四世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Midnight Tale》的上传日期列为2019-04-05，配器列为吉他、鲁特琴。
zh-CN.note: 一次拜访里已经有了故事：有人走来，有人在等。《Midnight Tale》的名字像一个邀请，让我们在这次山中相会旁再坐一会儿。

title: Gold and Silver Cloth
originalTitle: Gold and Silver Cloth × Limit 70

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Gold and Silver Cloth with the date late 16th century.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Limit 70 with an upload date of 2019-12-18 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Synths, Percussion.

note: Silk and metal thread give this brocade two materials to work with. Limit 70 brings electric piano, synths and percussion beside them. I chose the pairing for its shared interest in assembling a surface from distinct parts.

zh-CN.title: 金银织物
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Gold and Silver Cloth》的年代标为十六世纪晚期。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Limit 70》的上传日期列为2019-12-18，配器列为电钢琴、合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 丝线与金属线，是这块织锦使用的两种材料。《Limit 70》在旁边带来电钢琴、合成器与打击乐。选它们相伴，是因为两边都在用不同部分，构成一片完整的表面。

title: Looking through Lace
originalTitle: Lace Cloth × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Lace Cloth with the date 1500s.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Lace is made from threads and the spaces between them. A numbered piece from Cylinders gives this close inspection a simple frame: one textile, one recording, enough room to follow a line.

zh-CN.title: 细看蕾丝
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Lace Cloth》的年代标为十六世纪。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 蕾丝由线构成，也由线之间的空隙构成。《Cylinders》里的一首编号作品，为细看提供简单的范围：一件织物，一份录音，沿着一条线看下去。

title: Cloth with Lace
originalTitle: Cloth with Lace × Oxygen Garden

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Cloth with Lace with the date 1560–99.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Oxygen Garden, released on Divider (2011).

note: Cloth and lace meet at the edge of a handmade surface. Oxygen Garden supplies an unexpected garden for that small border, where decoration can be looked at with the same patience as a growing thing.

zh-CN.title: 布与花边
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Cloth with Lace》的年代标为1560–99年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Oxygen Garden，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 布与花边，在手作表面的边缘相接。《Oxygen Garden》为这道小边缘添了一座意外的花园，装饰也值得像生长中的东西一样慢慢看。

title: Winter Air
originalTitle: Untitled (Winter Landscape) × Fresh Air

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Untitled (Winter Landscape) with the date c. 1900.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Fresh Air with an upload date of 2015-12-21 and the instrumentation Piano.

note: An untitled winter landscape lets the season do the naming. Fresh Air, which began as a keyboard improvisation, makes a useful companion to a view that asks for a moment rather than an explanation.

zh-CN.title: 冬日的空气
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Untitled (Winter Landscape)》的年代标为约1900年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Fresh Air》的上传日期列为2015-12-21，配器列为钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 这张没有特定题名的冬景，让季节自己说话。由键盘即兴而来的《Fresh Air》，适合陪着这样的景色：先停一会儿，解释可以晚点再来。

title: Trees and Roots
originalTitle: Trees and Roots × Fresh Air

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Trees and Roots with the date 1900s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Fresh Air with an upload date of 2015-12-21 and the instrumentation Piano.

note: The photograph keeps trees and their roots within one subject. Fresh Air began as a piano improvisation; I chose a single-instrument piece so the pairing could stay with this one photographic study for a while.

zh-CN.title: 树与根
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Trees and Roots》的年代标为二十世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Fresh Air》的上传日期列为2015-12-21，配器列为钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 照片把树与树根留在同一个题材里。《Fresh Air》起于钢琴即兴；我选一件乐器的作品，是想让这一组可以陪着这张摄影习作待一会儿。

title: A Landscape without a Name
originalTitle: Untitled (Landscape) × Fresh Air

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Untitled (Landscape) with the date early 1860s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Fresh Air with an upload date of 2015-12-21 and the instrumentation Piano.

note: With no named destination to recognize, this photograph can remain a place to look. Fresh Air is similarly open as a title: enough of a cue for a pause between two pieces of work.

zh-CN.title: 无名的风景
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Untitled (Landscape)》的年代标为1860年代初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Fresh Air》的上传日期列为2015-12-21，配器列为钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 没有必须认出的地名，这张照片可以只是一处观看的地方。《Fresh Air》的名字也留得很开，刚好为两件工作之间的停顿提供一个提示。

title: A Landscape in Passing
originalTitle: Landscape (Paysage) × Floating Cities

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Landscape (Paysage) with the date c. 1857–1911.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Floating Cities with an upload date of 2016-04-04 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: An etched landscape gives a place permanence in lines. MacLeod imagines Floating Cities accompanying a wordless walking scene. I like bringing that idea of passing through a place beside an image that can stay for the whole afternoon.

zh-CN.title: 路过的风景
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Landscape (Paysage)》的年代标为约1857–1911年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Floating Cities》的上传日期列为2016-04-04，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 蚀刻风景用线条把一个地方留住。MacLeod设想《Floating Cities》可以陪着一段没有对白的步行画面。我喜欢把这种走过的感觉，放在能停留一整个下午的图像旁边。

title: Arkville, for a While
originalTitle: Arkville Landscape × Cylinder One

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Arkville Landscape with the date c. 1890.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Arkville gives the landscape a name we can return to. Cylinder One offers an equally definite starting point in its album, a small beginning beside a place already fixed on the page.

zh-CN.title: 在阿克维尔待一会儿
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Arkville Landscape》的年代标为约1890年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 阿克维尔为风景留下了一个可以重访的名字。《Cylinder One》也在专辑里提供明确的起点，一个小小的开始，陪着已经留在纸上的地方。

title: Trees, Stream, Hillside
originalTitle: Trees and a Stream on a Hillside × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Trees and a Stream on a Hillside with the date 1853.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Trees, a stream and a hillside form a set of relationships. Cylinder Seven makes a contemporary companion for looking between those named parts, letting a single landscape remain the whole task for a moment.

zh-CN.title: 树，溪流，山坡
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Trees and a Stream on a Hillside》的年代标为1853年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 树、溪流与山坡，构成了一组可以来回看的关系。《Cylinder Seven》陪着目光在它们之间移动，有一小会儿，眼前这幅风景就是全部事情。

title: Clouds on a Bowl
originalTitle: 청자 양각 구름무늬 사발 [靑磁陽刻雲文碗] × Floating Cities

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Bowl with Cloud Design in Relief with the date 1100s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Floating Cities with an upload date of 2016-04-04 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: Clouds in relief sit on a bowl made for use at close range. Floating Cities works with synths and percussion and an imagined cinematic setting; it gives this small ceramic sky another way to open out beyond the object.

zh-CN.title: 碗上的云
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Bowl with Cloud Design in Relief》的年代标为十二世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Floating Cities》的上传日期列为2016-04-04，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 浮雕云纹留在近处使用的碗上。《Floating Cities》以合成器和打击乐配器，并带着作者想象中的电影场景；这片小小的陶瓷天空，也有了向器物之外展开的方式。

title: A Flower-Shaped Mirror
originalTitle: 청동 꽃모양 거울 [銅製花形鏡] × Lobby Time

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flower-Shaped Mirror with the date 1100s–1200s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Lobby Time with an upload date of 2016-09-22 and the instrumentation Vibraphone, Piano, Bass, Drums.

note: This bronze mirror is only 9.2 centimetres across. Lobby Time combines vibraphone, piano, bass and drums; I wanted a small, shaped object beside that instrumental arrangement, something the eye can take in whole before returning to details.

zh-CN.title: 花形镜
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flower-Shaped Mirror》的年代标为十二至十三世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Lobby Time》的上传日期列为2016-09-22，配器列为颤音琴、钢琴、贝斯、鼓。
zh-CN.note: 这面铜镜的尺寸只有9.2厘米。《Lobby Time》由颤音琴、钢琴、贝斯与鼓配器；我想在这份安排旁边放一件轮廓明确的小东西，先看完整体，再慢慢回到细处。

title: Fish and Waves
originalTitle: 청자 양각 파도·물고기무늬 사발 [靑磁陽刻波漁文碗] × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Bowl with Fish and Waves in Relief with the date 1100s-1200s.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: Fish and waves bring a pictured world onto a vessel. The Oceans Continue to Rise enlarges that watery subject beyond the bowl, a useful shift of scale during a day spent on small details.

zh-CN.title: 鱼与水纹
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Bowl with Fish and Waves in Relief》的年代标为十二至十三世纪。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 鱼与波浪把一个图像世界带到容器上。《The Oceans Continue to Rise》将水的题材延伸到碗之外，在忙于细节的一天里，换一换尺度。

title: A Bamboo-Shoot Ewer
originalTitle: 청자 죽순모양 주전자 [靑磁竹筍形注子] × That Zen Moment

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Wine Ewer with Incised Bamboo Shoot Design with the date 1100s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: A growing plant becomes the shape of something used by a hand. The composer's account of finding a metal tongue drum gives this pairing another meeting between a useful object and an unexpected pleasure.

zh-CN.title: 竹笋形的酒壶
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Wine Ewer with Incised Bamboo Shoot Design》的年代标为十二世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 生长的植物，变成了可以拿在手里的器物形状。作曲家说，曲子缘于偶然遇到一只金属舌鼓；这一组也因此多了一次与物相遇的乐趣。

title: Beside the Brushes
originalTitle: 대나무 산수무늬 팔각필통 [竹山水文八各筆筒] × That Zen Moment

facts.text: This nineteenth-century Korean brush holder is carved from bamboo and decorated with bamboo and landscape motifs.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: A brush holder puts a landscape beside the act of writing. That Zen Moment began with the composer's attraction to a particular instrument; both halves start with something close enough to touch.

zh-CN.title: 笔筒旁
facts: 这件十九世纪韩国笔筒由竹材雕成，以竹与山水为装饰题材。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 笔筒把山水放到了书写旁边。《That Zen Moment》起于作曲家对一件具体乐器的喜欢，两边都是从手边的一件东西开始的。

title: A Flower for the Table
originalTitle: 청자 봉황무늬 꽃모양 접시 × That Zen Moment

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Celadon Dish with Molded Phoenix Design in the Shape of a Flower with the date 1200s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: A flower becomes the outline of a dish, bringing the garden onto the table. The chosen music also began with delight in a physical object: a metal tongue drum found in a shop.

zh-CN.title: 桌上的花形器
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Celadon Dish with Molded Phoenix Design in the Shape of a Flower》的年代标为十三世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 花变成盘子的轮廓，把花园带上了桌面。这里的音乐也起于对实物的喜欢：作曲家在店里遇见的一只金属舌鼓。

title: Looking at an Instrument
originalTitle: Lamellophone "thumb piano" × Kalimba Relaxation Music

facts.text: This twentieth-century lamellophone is attributed to a Bushoong-style maker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its materials include wood and iron.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kalimba Relaxation Music with an upload date of 2019-12-19 and the instrumentation Kalimba, Synth.

note: An exhibited lamellophone lets us study an instrument as an object. MacLeod's kalimba-and-synth piece offers a contemporary companion to that looking, making curiosity about how things sound part of the visit.

zh-CN.title: 看一件乐器
facts: 这件二十世纪拨片乐器归于刚果民主共和国的Bushoong风格制作者，材料包括木材和铁。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kalimba Relaxation Music》的上传日期列为2019-12-19，配器列为卡林巴、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 馆藏中的拨片乐器，让我们可以先把乐器当作实物细看。MacLeod的卡林巴与合成器作品陪着这份观看，也把“它会怎样发声”的好奇带了进来。

title: Made to Be Worn
originalTitle: Hat (laket mishiing) with a pin × Kalimba Relaxation Music

facts.text: The museum dates this Kuba-style laket mishiing to the early 1900s; the hat is woven from raffia and secured with a metal pin.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kalimba Relaxation Music with an upload date of 2019-12-19 and the instrumentation Kalimba, Synth.

note: A hat and its pin keep the body in the story of an object. The contemporary kalimba composition brings another small, tangible thing into the pairing, with making and handling as the connection.

zh-CN.title: 原本戴在头上
facts: 馆方将这顶库巴风格laket mishiing帽定年为二十世纪初；帽体以拉菲草编成，用金属帽针固定。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kalimba Relaxation Music》的上传日期列为2019-12-19，配器列为卡林巴、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 帽子和帽针，让一件馆藏仍与身体相连。当代的卡林巴作品，又带来一件可以拿在手里的东西；两者在制作与使用上相遇。

title: Time in Raffia
originalTitle: Embroidered Raffia Pile Cloth × Kalimba Relaxation Music

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Embroidered Raffia Pile Cloth with the date 1900s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kalimba Relaxation Music with an upload date of 2019-12-19 and the instrumentation Kalimba, Synth.

note: Embroidery makes duration visible through accumulated work. I put this raffia cloth beside the kalimba composition to give the hands that made things a place in an otherwise screen-filled workday.

zh-CN.title: 拉菲草里的时间
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Embroidered Raffia Pile Cloth》的年代标为二十世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kalimba Relaxation Music》的上传日期列为2019-12-19，配器列为卡林巴、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 刺绣把一点点积累的劳动留在表面。让这块拉菲草织物与卡林巴作品相伴，是想在满是屏幕的工作日里，也为制作东西的双手留个位置。

title: Commercial Street
originalTitle: Commercial Street, Canton (recto); Untitled (man being carried in sedan chair, verso) × Guzheng City

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Commercial Street, Canton (recto); Untitled (man being carried in sedan chair, verso) with the date c. 1860s & c. 1880s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Guzheng City with an upload date of 2021-02-11 and the instrumentation Guzheng, Percussion (Dhol).

note: This photograph has a commercial street on one side and a sedan-chair scene on the other. Guzheng City combines guzheng with dhol percussion. I chose that contemporary arrangement beside a record with two views of city life.

zh-CN.title: 商业街
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Commercial Street, Canton (recto); Untitled (man being carried in sedan chair, verso)》的年代标为约1860年代及约1880年代。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Guzheng City》的上传日期列为2021-02-11，配器列为古筝、打击乐（Dhol鼓）。
zh-CN.note: 照片一面是商业街，另一面是轿中的人。《Guzheng City》把古筝与dhol鼓放在一起。我选这份当代编排，陪着一件保存了两种城市生活视角的记录。

title: A Market in the Mountains
originalTitle: 산시청람도 [山市晴嵐圖] × Guzheng City

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Mountain Market, Clear with Rising Mist with the date early 1500s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Guzheng City with an upload date of 2021-02-11 and the instrumentation Guzheng, Percussion (Dhol).

note: A market makes the mountain landscape a place where people have business to do. Guzheng City's imagined urban setting meets that practical detail, a useful companion to our own day's work.

zh-CN.title: 山中的集市
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Mountain Market, Clear with Rising Mist》的年代标为十六世纪初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Guzheng City》的上传日期列为2021-02-11，配器列为古筝、打击乐（Dhol鼓）。
zh-CN.note: 集市让山水成了人们办事、往来的地方。《Guzheng City》设想中的城市，与这份实在的日常相遇，也陪着我们做今天的事。

title: September on Spring Street
originalTitle: Spring Street, September 1878 × Guzheng City

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Spring Street, September 1878 with the date 1878.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Guzheng City with an upload date of 2021-02-11 and the instrumentation Guzheng, Percussion (Dhol).

note: The title fixes a street in a particular month and year. Guzheng City opens a different, invented urban space beside it; work at the desk can happen between a documented city and an imagined one.

zh-CN.title: 春街的九月
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Spring Street, September 1878》的年代标为1878年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Guzheng City》的上传日期列为2021-02-11，配器列为古筝、打击乐（Dhol鼓）。
zh-CN.note: 题名把一条街固定在某年某月。《Guzheng City》在旁边打开另一座想象中的城，桌边的工作便发生在真实记录与虚构地点之间。

title: Below Doune Castle
originalTitle: A Mountain Rivulet Which Flows at the Foot of Doune Castle × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs A Mountain Rivulet Which Flows at the Foot of Doune Castle with the date 1844.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: This early photograph identifies a stream through the castle beside it. Music made for Neptune Flux places that documented landscape next to a digitally built world: two ways of giving someone a place to enter.

zh-CN.title: 杜恩城堡下
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《A Mountain Rivulet Which Flows at the Foot of Doune Castle》的年代标为1844年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 这张早期照片用溪边的城堡为水流定位。为《Neptune Flux》创作的音乐，把这处实景与数字构建的世界放在一起，都是给人一个可以进入的地方。

title: The Old Bridge
originalTitle: Safed Sang River and Old Bridge × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Safed Sang River and Old Bridge with the date 1878–80.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: A bridge divides a river view into the structure we can cross and water continuing beyond it. Cylinder Eight gives this historical photograph a contemporary setting, with time to look on either side.

zh-CN.title: 旧桥旁
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Safed Sang River and Old Bridge》的年代标为1878–80年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 桥把河景分成可以跨过的结构，与继续向前的河水。《Cylinder Eight》为历史照片安排了一个当代的相处时段，两边都可以多看一会儿。

title: The River, Again
originalTitle: Wiston River × Stories About the World That Once Was

facts.text: Frank Morley Fletcher made Wiston River in 1911 as a colour woodcut on Japanese paper.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Stories About the World That Once Was, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: A named river can survive in an image long after the day it was pictured. Stories About the World That Once Was makes this return to Wiston River a small encounter with what a picture keeps.

zh-CN.title: 再看一遍河流
facts: Frank Morley Fletcher于1911年制作《Wiston River》，以日本纸印制彩色木刻。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Stories About the World That Once Was，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 被画下的那一天过去后，有名字的河流仍留在图像里。《Stories About the World That Once Was》让这次重访维斯顿河，也成了与图像所保存之物的相遇。

title: A Mountain in Camera Work
originalTitle: Camera Work: Mountain Landscape × Airport Lounge

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Camera Work: Mountain Landscape with the date 1906.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Airport Lounge with an upload date of 2011-03-07 and the instrumentation Bass, Drum Kit, Electric Piano, Vibraphone.

note: A mountain is compressed into a photogravure in Camera Work. Electric piano and vibraphone give Airport Lounge a different set of materials to arrange beside it. The pairing holds a large view within the scale of an open magazine.

zh-CN.title: 《Camera Work》中的山
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Camera Work: Mountain Landscape》的年代标为1906年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Airport Lounge》的上传日期列为2011-03-07，配器列为贝斯、架子鼓、电钢琴、颤音琴。
zh-CN.note: 一座山被收进《Camera Work》中的照相凹版。电钢琴与颤音琴，为《Airport Lounge》提供了另一组可以安排的材料。这一组把辽阔的景色留在一本摊开杂志的尺度里。

title: Clouds, before Space
originalTitle: Fleecy Clouds × Oxygen Garden

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Fleecy Clouds with the date 1881.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Oxygen Garden, released on Divider (2011).

note: Fleecy Clouds keeps the sky within everyday weather. Oxygen Garden supplies a living, terrestrial word beside it, bringing the distant-looking subject back to the air around a working desk.

zh-CN.title: 飞向太空之前的云
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Fleecy Clouds》的年代标为1881年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Oxygen Garden，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 《Fleecy Clouds》把天空留在日常天气里。《Oxygen Garden》带来一个与地上生命有关的词，让看似遥远的题材，也回到书桌周围的空气中。

title: Fuji on Another Frequency
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Mount Fuji (Fuji) × Cylinder Four

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Mount Fuji (Fuji) with the date 1909–10.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Sekka’s broad white mountain gives the eye one large shape to return to. Cylinder Four keeps the music in Zabriskie’s contemporary numbered series; I chose one view and one piece as a compact place to begin a work session.

zh-CN.title: 另一频率上的富士山
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Mount Fuji (Fuji)》的年代标为1909–10年。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 雪佳画中大块的白色山形，给目光留下一个可以回来的轮廓。《Cylinder Four》来自Zabriskie的当代编号组曲；选一幅景和一首曲，为开始工作留一处小小的地方。

title: Riding a Carp
originalTitle: Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man Riding Carp) × Space Jazz

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man Riding Carp) with the date 1822.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Space Jazz with an upload date of 2021-09-29 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: A man riding a carp gives a small album page an impossible journey. Space Jazz began with a video-game brief; the two works meet in the pleasure of giving an invented world somewhere to go.

zh-CN.title: 骑着鲤鱼
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Miniature Album with Figures and Landscape (Man Riding Carp)》的年代标为1822年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Space Jazz》的上传日期列为2021-09-29，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 骑着鲤鱼的人，让小小册页有了一趟不可能的旅程。《Space Jazz》起于游戏创作中的要求，两件作品都在为想象中的世界安排去处。

title: A Fragment, a World
originalTitle: Palmettes and Birds from a Tunic or Curtain × Space Jazz

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Palmettes and Birds from a Tunic or Curtain with the date 500s–600s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Space Jazz with an upload date of 2021-09-29 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: A fragment of tunic or curtain can still hold birds and a whole ornamental setting. Space Jazz adds the premise of another constructed world, keeping this small surviving piece expansive.

zh-CN.title: 一片织物，一个世界
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Palmettes and Birds from a Tunic or Curtain》的年代标为六至七世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Space Jazz》的上传日期列为2021-09-29，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 一片来自衣服或帘幕的织物，仍能容下鸟与装饰构成的天地。《Space Jazz》带来另一种造世界的念头，让这块留存的小片也显得开阔。

title: Two Birds in a Square
originalTitle: Square Segmentum with Two Birds × Space Jazz

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Square Segmentum with Two Birds with the date 400s - 500s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Space Jazz with an upload date of 2021-09-29 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: The square gives two birds a world with a boundary. A piece commissioned around the idea of Space Jazz offers an unlikely neighbour: another little environment made to be entered.

zh-CN.title: 方形里的两只鸟
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Square Segmentum with Two Birds》的年代标为五至六世纪。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Space Jazz》的上传日期列为2021-09-29，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 方形为两只鸟围出了一小片天地。因“太空爵士”这个要求而诞生的音乐，成了意外的邻居，也像一个可以走进去的小环境。

title: At the Garden Entrance
originalTitle: Camera Work: Entrance to the Garden × Northern Glade

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Camera Work: Entrance to the Garden with the date 1908.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Northern Glade with an upload date of 2018-10-07 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: An entrance is a place of possibility before anything happens. Northern Glade belongs to MacLeod's deliberately uneventful game; it makes good company for a garden that can remain just beyond the gate.

zh-CN.title: 花园入口
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Camera Work: Entrance to the Garden》的年代标为1908年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Northern Glade》的上传日期列为2018-10-07，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 入口是事情尚未发生、可能性还在的地方。《Northern Glade》来自MacLeod刻意做得无事发生的游戏，适合陪着这座还可以留在门那边的花园。

title: Hemlocks by the Railway
originalTitle: Hemlock Forest, Lehigh Valley Railroad × Northern Glade

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Hemlock Forest, Lehigh Valley Railroad with the date c. 1895.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Northern Glade with an upload date of 2018-10-07 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: The photograph's title keeps the railroad beside the forest. Northern Glade brings a different kind of passage through a landscape, with room to linger instead of arriving on schedule.

zh-CN.title: 铁路边的铁杉林
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Hemlock Forest, Lehigh Valley Railroad》的年代标为约1895年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Northern Glade》的上传日期列为2018-10-07，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 照片的题名把铁路留在森林旁边。《Northern Glade》带来另一种穿行风景的方式，可以逗留一会儿，让抵达晚一点发生。

title: The Forest Entrance
originalTitle: Landscapes:  The Entrance of a Forest × Northern Glade

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Landscapes:  The Entrance of a Forest with the date 1829.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Northern Glade with an upload date of 2018-10-07 and the instrumentation Synths.

note: A forest entrance and a game glade both begin with somewhere to wander. This pairing suits the few minutes before returning to work, when looking around is enough of an activity.

zh-CN.title: 森林入口
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Landscapes:  The Entrance of a Forest》的年代标为1829年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Northern Glade》的上传日期列为2018-10-07，配器列为合成器。
zh-CN.note: 森林入口与游戏中的林间空地，都从一处可以闲逛的地方开始。这一组适合回到工作前的几分钟，四下看看，本身就很够了。

title: Gibbons in the Landscape
originalTitle: 원숭이유희도 (群猿遊戱圖) × Kawai Kitsune

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Gibbons in a Landscape with the date early 1900s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kawai Kitsune with an upload date of 2015-09-06 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: Gibbons bring an animal presence into the landscape. The electronic premise of Kawai Kitsune gives that encounter a contemporary neighbour, like keeping a small illustrated world open beside one's work.

zh-CN.title: 山水里的猿
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Gibbons in a Landscape》的年代标为二十世纪初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kawai Kitsune》的上传日期列为2015-09-06，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 猿让山水里多了动物的身影。《Kawai Kitsune》的电子设定，为这次相遇带来一个当代邻居，像在工作旁边开着一小幅图画世界。

title: A Bird Asleep
originalTitle: 매화나무 위의 졸고 있는 새 [梅竹鳥圖] × Kawai Kitsune

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Bird Sleeping on a Plum Tree with the date early 1900s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kawai Kitsune with an upload date of 2015-09-06 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: The sleeping bird has already found somewhere to rest. MacLeod lists synths and percussion for Kawai Kitsune; the electronic setting gives this early-twentieth-century painting a present-day companion for quiet work.

zh-CN.title: 睡着的鸟
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Bird Sleeping on a Plum Tree》的年代标为二十世纪初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kawai Kitsune》的上传日期列为2015-09-06，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 睡着的鸟已经找到了歇脚处。MacLeod为《Kawai Kitsune》列出的配器是合成器与打击乐，这份电子设定让二十世纪初的画也有了今天的工作陪伴。

title: A Bird, Made by Hand
originalTitle: Bird × Kawai Kitsune

facts.text: This twentieth-century ivory bird is by an unknown maker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The museum considers it likely to have been made as a souvenir.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kawai Kitsune with an upload date of 2015-09-06 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: An unnamed maker's bird and a piece built from synths and percussion approach invention at different scales. I like having both here: one recognizable creature beside a deliberately electronic world.

zh-CN.title: 手做的鸟
facts: 这件二十世纪的象牙鸟雕由刚果民主共和国的无名制作者完成；馆方认为它很可能是一件纪念品。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kawai Kitsune》的上传日期列为2015-09-06，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 无名制作者的鸟，与以合成器和打击乐构成的作品，从不同尺度接近创造。我喜欢让它们待在一起：一只认得出的动物，旁边是电子构成的世界。

title: Chrysanthemum and Paulownia
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Chrysanthemum and Paulownia (Kikukiri) × Bleeping Demo

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Chrysanthemum and Paulownia (Kikukiri) with the date 1909–10.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Bleeping Demo with an upload date of 2020-11-18 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: Two plants share a printed design, each keeping its own identity. The listed synths and percussion of Bleeping Demo give this pairing another way to think about distinct parts made to occupy one frame.

zh-CN.title: 菊与桐
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Chrysanthemum and Paulownia (Kikukiri)》的年代标为1909–10年。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Bleeping Demo》的上传日期列为2020-11-18，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 两种植物共处一幅印刷设计，仍各有自己的样子。《Bleeping Demo》列出的合成器与打击乐，让这一组也关乎不同部分怎样待在同一个框里。

title: A Heron in Printed Cotton
originalTitle: Roller-Printed Cotton with Heron and Flower Design × Bleeping Demo

facts.text: This English cotton textile dates to the nineteenth century and was roller-printed with a heron-and-flower design.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Bleeping Demo with an upload date of 2020-11-18 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: Roller printing turns an image into cloth that can extend beyond a single picture. Bleeping Demo brings an electronic production process beside that mechanical one, joining two ways of making a decorative surface.

zh-CN.title: 印花棉布上的鹭
facts: 这件英国棉织物定年为十九世纪，以滚筒印制鹭鸟与花卉图案。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Bleeping Demo》的上传日期列为2020-11-18，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 滚筒印花把图像变成可以延展的布面。《Bleeping Demo》的电子制作，与这道机械工艺并排，像两种不同材料上的装饰实验。

title: Silk for Wearing
originalTitle: Silk "Sampot" (Loin Cloth) × Bleeping Demo

facts.text: This early-twentieth-century Cambodian sampot uses silk, plain weave and weft ikat.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Bleeping Demo with an upload date of 2020-11-18 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: A sampot belongs to the scale and movement of a body. Synths and percussion place this silk textile beside another made surface, one assembled in sound and carried through the room.

zh-CN.title: 穿在身上的丝
facts: 这件二十世纪初的柬埔寨桑波特围裳，以丝线采用平纹组织和纬线絣染制作。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Bleeping Demo》的上传日期列为2020-11-18，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 桑波特围裳属于身体的尺度与活动。合成器和打击乐让丝织物旁边多了另一种制作出来的表面，由声音构成，在房间里展开。

title: Bamboo in 1934
originalTitle: 바람 속의 대나무 × Cylinder Four

facts.text: Kim Jin-woo made Bamboos in Wind in 1934 as a ten-panel folding screen in ink on paper, during Korea’s Japanese colonial period.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The museum dates this Korean bamboo painting to 1934. A piece from the 2014 album Cylinders places two made works eighty years apart beside each other, while the working day supplies a third time of its own.

zh-CN.title: 1934年的竹
facts: 金振宇于1934年、朝鲜半岛处于日本殖民统治期间，以纸本水墨绘成十扇屏风《风竹》。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 馆方将这幅韩国竹画定年为1934年。《Cylinders》发行于2014年，相隔八十年的两件作品在这里相伴，今天的工作日又带来第三个时间。

title: One Word: Bamboo
originalTitle: 묵죽도 [墨竹圖] × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: The museum identifies this twentieth-century Korean ink-on-silk hanging scroll as a modern imitation of a bamboo painting by Yi Jeong.
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: The museum identifies this bamboo scroll as a modern imitation of an older painting. Carlo Alberto Boni's performance of Tárrega offers another way to return to an existing work: making it present again through someone's hands.

zh-CN.title: 一个字题：竹
facts: 馆方说明，这幅二十世纪韩国绢本水墨立轴，是对李霆竹画的近代仿作。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 馆方说明，这幅竹画是对较早作品的近代仿作。Carlo Alberto Boni演奏的塔雷加，则提供了重访已有作品的另一种方式：经过一双手，让它再次来到眼前。

title: A Creeper in the Garden
originalTitle: A Creeper in the Peradeniya Gardens, Ceylon × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Scowen & Co. made this albumen photograph around 1880 in Peradeniya Gardens, in present-day Sri Lanka. The gardens were formally established by the colonial government in 1843.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The photograph identifies a creeper in the Peradeniya Gardens. La Pianista's solo-piano recording keeps the music equally specific, so the pairing begins with two particular encounters rather than a generalized idea of nature.

zh-CN.title: 园中的藤蔓
facts: Scowen & Co.约于1880年在今天斯里兰卡的佩拉德尼亚植物园拍摄了这张蛋白相纸照片；植物园由殖民政府于1843年正式设立。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 照片记录佩拉德尼亚植物园的一株藤蔓。La Pianista的钢琴独奏也带来具体的一次演奏，植物和音乐因此都可以从各自的细处慢慢认识。

title: A Landscape Woven in Silk
originalTitle: Silk Textile with Goatherds in a Landscape × 流水

facts.text: This Isfahan textile was woven in the 1900s, despite an inscription giving a date equivalent to 1523. It imitates earlier Safavid textiles.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: Silk carries goatherds and a landscape into cloth. Charlie Huang's recording of Flowing Water adds a second way for a landscape subject to travel, this time as the title of a performed musical work.

zh-CN.title: 织进丝里的山水
facts: 这件伊斯法罕织物虽然带有相当于1523年的纪年题铭，实际织于二十世纪，仿效较早的萨法维织物。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 丝织物把牧人和山水带进布面。黄查理演奏的《流水》，让自然题材有了另一种远行的方式，这次是以乐曲的名字进入一次演奏。

title: Threads Meeting
originalTitle: Ceremonial Cloth × Limit 70

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Ceremonial Cloth with the date early 1900s.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Limit 70 with an upload date of 2019-12-18 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Synths, Percussion.

note: Double ikat prepares both warp and weft before they meet in the weave. Limit 70 was conceived around the passing of road markings at a particular speed. Both invite attention to alignment: separate elements meeting in an ordered sequence.

zh-CN.title: 经纬相遇
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Ceremonial Cloth》的年代标为二十世纪初。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Limit 70》的上传日期列为2019-12-18，配器列为电钢琴、合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 双面絣先处理经线与纬线，再让它们在织造中相遇。《Limit 70》的构思与特定车速下掠过的道路标线有关。两边都让人留意对齐：各自分开的部分，怎样按次序遇在一起。

title: A Cloth from Fiji
originalTitle: Tapa Cloth × Deuxième Arabesque

facts.text: This Fijian tapa cloth is made from mulberry bark; the museum dates it to before 1971.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 2 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: The museum associates this tapa cloth with Fiji. Patrizia Prati's piano recording gives the textile a deliberately personal musical neighbour, making this an encounter between two particular works across different histories.

zh-CN.title: 斐济的布
facts: 这件斐济塔帕布以构树皮制成，馆方将年代标为1971年以前。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第二号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 馆方将这件塔帕布归于斐济。Patrizia Prati的钢琴录音，为织物带来一位具体的音乐邻居，两件作品也就带着各自的历史在此相遇。

title: Bamboo in Moonlight
originalTitle: 월하묵죽도 [月下墨竹圖] × 流水

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Bamboo in Moonlight with the date 1500s.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: Moonlight changes the occasion for looking at bamboo. I chose Charlie Huang's guqin recording of Flowing Water so that the pairing holds two natural subjects, one pictured and one named by a musical work.

zh-CN.title: 月下竹
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Bamboo in Moonlight》的年代标为十六世纪。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 月光改变了看竹的时刻。选黄查理的古琴《流水》录音，让这一组容下两种自然题材：一种由画呈现，一种留在乐曲的名字里。

title: Watching Fish
originalTitle: Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish × 陽關三疊

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish with the date 1745.
This recording of Yangguan Sandie is performed on guqin by Charlie Huang (Charles R Tsua).

note: A scholar watching fish gives attention a visible subject. Beside Charlie Huang's guqin recording of Yangguan Sandie, the scene becomes company for a study break spent watching rather than collecting another fact.

zh-CN.title: 看鱼
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Album of Landscape Paintings Illustrating Old Poems: Scholar watching Fish》的年代标为1745年。
这份《阳关三叠》录音由Charlie Huang（Charles R Tsua）以古琴演奏。
zh-CN.note: 文人看鱼，让专注有了一个看得见的对象。配上黄查理的古琴《阳关三叠》，这幅画也成了读书间隙的陪伴，看一会儿就很满足。

title: Watching Rain Clouds
originalTitle: Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa × Raga Kaushi Kanra

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa with the date c. 1790.
Ranjit Makkuni performs Raga Kaushi Kanra on sitar, with Akram Khan on tabla, in this recording.

note: The painting belongs to a sequence of months, making weather a measure of time. Ranjit Makkuni's sitar with Akram Khan's tabla brings another sustained practice beside that seasonal attention.

zh-CN.title: 看雨云
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Royal lovers watching rain clouds: The month of Bhadon, from a Barahmasa》的年代标为约1790年。
这份Raga Kaushi Kanra录音由Ranjit Makkuni演奏西塔琴，Akram Khan演奏塔布拉鼓。
zh-CN.note: 这幅画属于描绘月份的组画，以天气感知时间。Ranjit Makkuni的西塔琴与Akram Khan的塔布拉鼓，在这份对季节的留意旁，带来另一种长时间的练习。

title: Deer, Phoenix, Lotus
originalTitle: Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms with the date 1300–1350.
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: A dish gathers several living forms into one usable object. Carlo Alberto Boni's guitar recording keeps the musical side at the scale of one named performer, a close companion to this small painted world.

zh-CN.title: 鹿、凤凰与莲花
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Ceramic dish with deer, phoenix, and lotus blossoms》的年代标为1300–1350年。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 一只盘子把几种生灵收进日用器物。Carlo Alberto Boni的吉他录音，让音乐这一边也保持在一位具体演奏者的尺度，陪着这个小小的彩绘世界。

title: Wisteria on a Page
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji) × Première Arabesque

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji) with the date 1909–10.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 1 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: A flowering plant becomes a design that can be revisited on the page. Patrizia Prati's recording of Debussy's first Arabesque brings another worked arrangement beside it: a piano score given a particular performance.

zh-CN.title: 纸上的紫藤
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): Wisteria (Fuji)》的年代标为1909–10年。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 开花的植物变成纸上可以反复看的设计。Patrizia Prati演奏的德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》，在旁边带来另一种安排：乐谱成为一次具体的演奏。

title: Orchid Blossoms
originalTitle: Orchid Blossoms × Deuxième Arabesque

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Orchid Blossoms with the date 1873.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 2 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: Heade's orchid paintings grew out of travels in Central and South America. I put this canvas beside Patrizia Prati's solo-piano Debussy to bring the scale back to a room: a journey kept in paint, with one instrument for company.

zh-CN.title: 兰花
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Orchid Blossoms》的年代标为1873年。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第二号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 海德的兰花题材与他在中南美洲的旅行有关。我让这幅油画与Patrizia Prati的德彪西钢琴独奏相伴，把尺度带回房间：一次旅行留在画里，一件乐器陪在身旁。

title: A River on a Bottle
originalTitle: 백자 청화 산수무늬 사각병 [白磁靑畫山水文四角甁] × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: This nineteenth-century Korean blue-and-white porcelain bottle depicts the Han River. Its separate facets were assembled before firing.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The Han River appears on a square-shaped bottle, turning a landscape into something that can sit on a shelf. La Pianista's solo-piano Satie gives this compact view a companion at the desk.

zh-CN.title: 瓶上的江景
facts: 这件十九世纪韩国青花瓷瓶描绘汉江景色；各面分别制作后，在入窑烧制前组装起来。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 汉江风景出现在方形瓶上，山水成了可以摆在架上的东西。La Pianista的萨蒂钢琴独奏，陪着这处小景来到书桌边。

title: Returning to the Heron
originalTitle: Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi) × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: The Cleveland Museum of Art catalogs Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi) with the date 1909–10.
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

note: A familiar print can deserve another visit. Teknopazzo's recording of the first Gymnopédie changes the musical company for Sekka's heron, making a small return possible during an ordinary workday.

zh-CN.title: 再看白鹭
facts: 克利夫兰艺术博物馆将这件《Flowers of a Hundred Worlds (Momoyogusa): White Heron (Shirosagi)》的年代标为1909–10年。
这份萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》录音署名Teknopazzo，文件修复者为Mitar，以CC0发布。
zh-CN.note: 熟悉的版画，也值得再看一次。Teknopazzo录制的《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》为雪佳的白鹭换了音乐陪伴，让平常的工作日里也有一次小小重访。

title: Synthwave Radio
originalTitle: synthwave radio 🌌 beats to chill/game to

facts.text: Lofi Girl publishes this synthwave broadcast and credits its artwork to Lofi Studio.

note: The animated room and synthesizers belong to the same broadcast. Keeping them together lets a contemporary drawn world occupy the room without adding a second visual story.

title: Anjunadeep Radio
originalTitle: Anjunadeep Radio • Live 24/7 • Best of Deep House, Chill, House, Progressive • Work From Home

facts.text: Anjunadeep labels this live broadcast with deep house, chill, house and progressive music in its title.

note: A more rhythm-led choice for times when a quiet piano feels too still. Tracks change within the broadcast; individual songs and vocals depend on the station.

title: Chillhop Essentials
originalTitle: Essentials Radio - chill beats to enjoy Fall to 🍁

facts.text: Chillhop Music publishes Essentials Radio. The currently verified broadcast is titled for the fall season.

note: This selection keeps the station’s illustrated scene with the music curated for it. The illustration can stay familiar while the tracks change underneath it.

title: Claude FM
originalTitle: Claude FM 🎵 music for thinking and building

facts.text: This broadcast is published on the Claude YouTube channel under the title “Claude FM — music for thinking and building”.

note: Keep the broadcast's own changing scene and music together. Its current track comes from the station, so FM does not attach a fixed composer or work title to it.

title: Glaciers near the Strait of Magellan
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Near the Straits of Magellan - Glaciers.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The broken white of the glaciers calls for a long ambient span rather than another sharply drawn line.

zh-CN.title: 麦哲伦海峡附近的冰川
facts: 档案文件夹标注为麦哲伦海峡附近的冰川。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-01；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 冰川的白色被云切开；配一段铺开的氛围，让碎片有地方连起来。

title: At the edge of the Namib
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 47 Crewmember. × That Zen Moment

facts.text: ISS047e022280 (03/26/2016) --- This interesting Earth observation image from the International Space Station seems an abstract painting but is really the outskirts of the Namib Desert in southwest Africa. One of the oldest and largest deserts in the world, the Namib stretches inland from the Atlantic Ocean, covering large swathes of Namibia and parts of Angola and South Africa. This arid hotspot surprisingly supports a diverse number of plants and animals, some of which are found nowhere else in the world.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: A bowl-drum-and-strings palette sits beside the dune folds without turning this aerial view into a desert adventure.

zh-CN.title: 纳米布沙漠边缘
facts: NASA将这里识别为非洲西南部纳米布沙漠的边缘。 NASA档案日期：2016-03-26；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 沙丘像折起的纸；弦乐与钵鼓放在旁边，不把这张俯瞰照配成沙漠冒险。

title: Salar de Uyuni
originalTitle: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 43 crew × Cylinder Four

facts.text: ISS043E184521 (05/10/2015) --- NASA astronaut Terry Virts Expedition 43 Commander on the International Space Station tweeted this Earth observation image of South America with the following comment: "Salar de Uyuni in the #Bolivia desert #SouthAmerica. The world's largest salt flat".
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The salt flat is a pale interruption in a darker field; a small ambient piece leaves that interruption intact.

zh-CN.title: 乌尤尼盐沼
facts: NASA的原始说明引用宇航员的说明，将这里标为玻利维亚乌尤尼盐沼。 NASA档案日期：2015-05-10；摄影：Terry Virts。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 盐地在深色地表中空出一块；短小的氛围段落把这处空白留住。

title: Southern islands
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. Image was released by astronaut on Twitter and downlinked in folder: south islands.
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

note: A few islands, a great deal of blue: Satie gives the sparse composition a human-sized pace.

zh-CN.title: 南方岛屿
facts: 原始档案将这幅影像归入“south islands”文件夹，未给出更确切地名。 NASA档案日期：2014-03-30；摄影：Rick Mastracchio。
这份萨蒂《第一号吉姆诺佩蒂》录音署名Teknopazzo，文件修复者为Mitar，以CC0发布。
zh-CN.note: 岛屿很少，蓝色很多；萨蒂给这个疏朗的构图一个人的步速。

title: The Bahamas from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: ISS047e069406 (04/20/2016) ---Earth observation image taken by the Expedition 47 crew aboard the International Space Station. This is an oblique south-looking view of the main Bahama island chain.  Cuba is across the entire top of the image, the Florida Peninsula on the right margin. In the Bahamas, the main Andros island is just distinguishable under cloud upper left of center.  Under less cloud is the Abaco Islands in the foreground (middle of pic nearest camera left of center.)
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: I borrow an underwater game's score for the shallows seen from above; the two viewpoints meet at the water.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰巴哈马
facts: NASA说明这是朝南斜望巴哈马主岛链的视角，画面上方可见古巴。 NASA档案日期：2016-04-20；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 借一段水下游戏配乐，陪从上方看见的浅海；两个视角在水面相遇。

title: Artificial islands from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedtion 38 crewmember × Cylinder One

facts.text: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 38 crewmember.  Crewmember indicates Middle East man-made Islands.  Image was released by astronaut on Twitter.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The engineered coastline has almost diagrammatic edges; ambient music lets the photograph stay a view, not a plan.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰人工岛
facts: 档案引用机组成员的说明，将这里称为中东的人工岛。 NASA档案日期：2013-11-12；摄影：Rick Mastracchio。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 人工海岸的边缘近似图纸；放上氛围音乐，让它仍是一眼风景。

title: Coast and river from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × 流水

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).   Folder lists this as: Chappaquiddick Island also Niagra Falls Hudson etc.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: Water branches between settled ground; guqin makes a useful companion to following those bends.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道俯瞰海岸与河流
facts: 档案文件夹列出数处地点，不能据此唯一确认本帧位置。 NASA档案日期：2014-07-05；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 水在有人居住的地表间分岔；古琴适合陪目光沿着这些转弯走。

title: Islands and a visiting spacecraft
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. A portion of the docked Soyuz TMA-11M spacecraft is in view. Image was released by astronaut on Instagram and downlinked in folder: Personal photos and the Maldive islands.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: The spacecraft at the edge supplies the scale. A game score leaves room for the journey without inventing a mission.

zh-CN.title: 岛屿与来访的飞船
facts: NASA说明画面中可见对接的联盟TMA-11M飞船的一部分。 NASA档案日期：2014-04-10；摄影：Steve Swanson。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 边缘的飞船给出尺度；游戏配乐添一点远行感，不替照片编造任务。

title: The Galápagos Islands
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Oxygen Garden

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: The Galápagos Islands.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Oxygen Garden, released on Divider (2011).

note: Clouds interrupt the island shapes. Oxygen Garden is chosen as a garden-like association, not a description of this ecosystem.

zh-CN.title: 加拉帕戈斯群岛
facts: 档案引用宇航员发布的文字，将这里识别为加拉帕戈斯群岛。 NASA档案日期：2013-08-13；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Oxygen Garden，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 云把岛的形状遮断；《Oxygen Garden》带来花园的联想，不替这里的生态作说明。

title: Sunset over Kazakhstan
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Sunsetting over the mountains of Kazakhstan.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: The narrowing light at the horizon is why I chose Heliograph: a correspondence of titles and light, not an astronomical claim.

zh-CN.title: 哈萨克斯坦上空的日落
facts: 原始档案文件夹将这里标为哈萨克斯坦山地上空的日落。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-26；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 地平线的光渐渐收窄，所以选《Heliograph》；这是光与曲名的联想。

title: Clouds over the Caspian Sea
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: intersecting clouds over the Caspian Sea & Caucasus Mountains.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Cloud bands and mountain ridges overlap; an ambient layer avoids choosing which line the eye must follow.

zh-CN.title: 里海上空的云
facts: 档案引用的宇航员文字提到里海与高加索山脉上空交错的云。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-17；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 云带与山脊叠在一起；氛围层不替眼睛决定该沿哪一道线看。

title: A mountain passage
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Danseuses de Delphes

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Possibly identified as Dzungarian Gate, mountain pass between China and Kazakhstan.
Patrizia Prati performs Debussy’s piano prelude Danseuses de Delphes in this recording.

note: The passage between dark slopes feels architectural. Debussy's piano offers a measured way through it.

zh-CN.title: 山间通道
facts: NASA档案认为这里可能是中国与哈萨克斯坦之间的准噶尔门，识别仍有不确定性。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-21；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Patrizia Prati在这份录音中演奏德彪西钢琴前奏曲《德尔斐的舞女》。
zh-CN.note: 深色山坡间的通道有建筑般的形状；德彪西的钢琴给它从容的步幅。

title: Brukkaros Mountain
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by Expedition 47 Crewmember. × That Zen Moment

facts.text: ISS047e022293 (03/26/2016) --- This Earth Observation image from the International Space Station  is of a large extinct volcano in the lower southwest African Brukkaros Mountain in the country of Namibia.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: The isolated circular mountain gets a spare strings-and-bowl-drum setting; no triumphant summit music is needed.

zh-CN.title: 布鲁卡罗斯山
facts: NASA将这里识别为纳米比亚布鲁卡罗斯山的一座大型死火山。 NASA档案日期：2016-03-26；摄影：Jeff Williams。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 独立的环形山体配疏落的弦乐与钵鼓，不必加一段登顶凯歌。

title: The Tien Shan range
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: Earth observation taken by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).  Per Twitter message: Tien Shan mountain range, Central Asia.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Snow and cloud are difficult to separate here; the long ambient selection permits that uncertainty.

zh-CN.title: 天山山脉
facts: 档案引用宇航员文字，将画面识别为中亚天山山脉。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-01；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 这里的雪与云不容易分开；长一些的氛围段落容得下这种含混。

title: Ruvuma River
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × 流水

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: Ruvuma River,  Tanzania and Mozambique.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: The river nearly disappears among the cloud marks; Flowing Water gives the eye a thread to recover.

zh-CN.title: 鲁伍马河
facts: 原始说明将画面标为坦桑尼亚与莫桑比克之间的鲁伍马河。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-12；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 河在云点中几乎消失；《流水》给目光留一条可以重新找出的线。

title: The Mississippi River
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Per Twitter message: The Mississippi River through Missouri, Tennessee, Arkansas, Mississippi.
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: The river's deliberate bends meet Satie's piano; I like the contrast with the much straighter traces nearby.

zh-CN.title: 密西西比河
facts: 档案文字提到密西西比河穿过密苏里、田纳西、阿肯色和密西西比一带。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-14；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
La Pianista在这份录音中以钢琴演奏萨蒂《第二号玄秘曲》。
zh-CN.note: 河道的弯折遇上萨蒂钢琴，旁边较直的地表痕迹因此更值得看。

title: Morning fog in river valleys
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Candlepower

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  Per Twitter message: Early morning fog in the river valleys of Ohio and West Virginia.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Candlepower, released on Divider (2011).

note: Fog draws light branches across dark ground. Candlepower is a small-light association at this enormous scale.

zh-CN.title: 河谷晨雾
facts: 档案引用宇航员文字，描述俄亥俄州和西弗吉尼亚州河谷中的晨雾。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-27；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Candlepower，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 雾在暗地上画出亮枝条；用《Candlepower》的小光，陪这个巨大的尺度。

title: Rivers in Brazil
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Arabesque No. 1

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: Amazing rivers in Brazil.
Debussy’s Arabesque No. 1 is performed on piano by Patrizia Prati in this recording.

note: Several river lines share the frame; the Arabesque is chosen for its branching idea rather than a national association.

zh-CN.title: 巴西的河流
facts: NASA档案引用宇航员文字，将这些河流标为位于巴西。 NASA档案日期：2013-07-29；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
这份录音由Patrizia Prati以钢琴演奏德彪西《第一号阿拉伯风格曲》。
zh-CN.note: 几条河线共用一个画面；选《阿拉伯风格曲》是取枝蔓的联想，不是地域对应。

title: Sun glint from orbit
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  Folder lists this as: Eastern half of US, sun glint, Texas, Maryland, Mississippi river, Great Lakes.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: The sun-glint spreads across an entire curve of Earth; Heliograph keeps light, rather than travel, at the centre.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看太阳反光
facts: 档案文件夹提到美国东部与水面的太阳反光，未唯一确认本帧地名。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-14；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 反光越过地球的弧面；《Heliograph》让光本身成为这组的中心。

title: Libya toward the Mediterranean
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Cylinder Four

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: Southwest Libya to the Mediterranean coast.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Four, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The oblique view stretches the desert into a band. An ambient miniature leaves its apparent speed unresolved.

zh-CN.title: 从利比亚望向地中海
facts: 档案文字描述从利比亚西南部到地中海沿岸的视野。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-11；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Four，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 斜看的沙漠被拉成一条带；短小的氛围让那种速度感悬着。

title: Along the eastern coast
originalTitle: Earth Observations taken by the Expedition 39 Crew × Evening

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 39 crew aboard the ISS. Image was released by astronaut on Instagram and downlinked in folder: Florida and up the East coast.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Evening with an upload date of 2023-08-15 and the instrumentation Guitar, Cello, Oboe.

note: Coast and inland texture share a muted frame; guitar, cello and oboe offer a warmer counterweight.

zh-CN.title: 沿着东海岸
facts: 原始文件夹标签是佛罗里达及美国东海岸一带。 NASA档案日期：2014-04-12；摄影：Steve Swanson。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Evening》的上传日期列为2023-08-15，配器列为吉他、大提琴、双簧管。
zh-CN.note: 海岸和内陆纹理都收在暗色里；吉他、大提琴与双簧管给它一点温暖的对照。

title: The southwest coast of Peru
originalTitle: Earth Observation × A New Day In a New Sector

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Per Twitter message: Southwest coast of Peru.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed A New Day In a New Sector, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: The sharp curve against black space feels like crossing a boundary; the chosen game score belongs to that threshold.

zh-CN.title: 秘鲁西南海岸
facts: 档案引用的宇航员文字将画面标为秘鲁西南海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-07-26；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏A New Day In a New Sector，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 弧形地表挨着黑色太空，像一道边界；这段游戏配乐陪的是跨过去之前的一刻。

title: Somalia and the Indian Ocean
originalTitle: Earth Observation × The Oceans Continue to Rise

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).  Per Twitter message: Coast of Somalia on the Indian Ocean.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed The Oceans Continue to Rise, released on Music from Neptune Flux (2016).

note: Sea, land and the thin horizon occupy separate bands. The underwater score quietly reverses our viewing direction.

zh-CN.title: 索马里与印度洋
facts: 档案文字将画面识别为索马里濒临印度洋的海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-09-08；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏The Oceans Continue to Rise，收录于2016年的《Music from Neptune Flux》。
zh-CN.note: 海、陆和地平线分成几层；水下配乐悄悄把观看方向倒转。

title: The coast of Namibia
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Midnight Tale

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 37 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS). Identified via Twitter message as west central coast of Namibia.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Midnight Tale with an upload date of 2019-04-05 and the instrumentation Guitar, Lute.

note: The coast has the colour of old paper; guitar and lute make this vast surface feel closer to hand.

zh-CN.title: 纳米比亚海岸
facts: NASA说明依据宇航员发布的文字将这里识别为纳米比亚中西部海岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-25；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Midnight Tale》的上传日期列为2019-04-05，配器列为吉他、鲁特琴。
zh-CN.note: 海岸带着旧纸的颜色；吉他和鲁特琴把这大片地表拉近到手边。

title: West coast after dark
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Late Night Radio

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  File lists this as: small timelapse of US west coast at night (ISS040E010215 thru ISS040E010257).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Late Night Radio with an upload date of 2021-03-25 and the instrumentation Electric Piano, Bass, Drums, Synth.

note: Scattered city lights suggest many separate desks still occupied; the electric-piano radio selection is their imagined company.

zh-CN.title: 入夜后的西海岸
facts: 这是NASA所列美国西海岸夜间延时序列中的一个独立画面；本批只选此序列的一帧。 NASA档案日期：2014-06-11；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Late Night Radio》的上传日期列为2021-03-25，配器列为电钢琴、贝斯、鼓、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 零散灯光让人想到还亮着的书桌；电钢琴电台只是给这些桌边的想象作伴。

title: East coast before dawn
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Vibing Over Venus

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).  Folder lists this as: US East Coast pre-dawn. City lights.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Vibing Over Venus with an upload date of 2023-08-15 and the instrumentation Vibraphone, Bass, Drum Kit, Percussion, Strings, Piano.

note: The bright coast is almost a necklace. Vibraphone-led instrumentation offers a second set of small points.

zh-CN.title: 黎明前的东海岸
facts: 档案文件夹将画面标为美国东海岸黎明前的城市灯光。 NASA档案日期：2014-08-06；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Vibing Over Venus》的上传日期列为2023-08-15，配器列为颤音琴、贝斯、架子鼓、打击乐、弦乐、钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 明亮海岸像一串珠；颤音琴为主的编制，给它添另一组小亮点。

title: Lights along the eastern Mediterranean
originalTitle: Earth Observation taken during the Expedition 37 mission × Study And Relax

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 37 crew.  City lights visible.  Per Twitter message this is eastern Mediterranean coast, Tel Aviv to Beirut.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Study And Relax with an upload date of 2020-01-08 and the instrumentation Saxophones, Piano, Bass, Percussion.

note: The illuminated shoreline is dense but legible; a restrained beat is a way of staying with that density.

zh-CN.title: 地中海东岸的灯光
facts: 档案文字将画面标为从特拉维夫到贝鲁特的地中海东岸。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-18；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Study And Relax》的上传日期列为2020-01-08，配器列为萨克斯、钢琴、贝斯、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 灯火密集，海岸线仍读得清；选一段克制的节拍，陪这种密度停一会儿。

title: Sunrise through an aurora
originalTitle: Aurora sequence × Floating Cities

facts.text: ISS043E155854 (04/27/2015) --- A rising sun spreads across the Earth and through the green blooming aurora to silhouette the blackened outline of the International Space Station on the morning of Apr. 27, 2015.
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Floating Cities with an upload date of 2016-04-04 and the instrumentation Synths, Percussion.

note: The aurora makes a luminous edge to the frame; Floating Cities lends an electronic setting without pretending to be space sound.

zh-CN.title: 穿过极光的日出
facts: NASA说明记载，2015年4月27日的日出穿过绿色极光，空间站形成剪影。 NASA档案日期：2015-04-27；摄影：Terry Virts。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Floating Cities》的上传日期列为2016-04-04，配器列为合成器、打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 极光替画面镶了一道亮边；《Floating Cities》提供电子背景，不冒充太空里的声音。

title: Aurora and the station arm
originalTitle: Earth Observation - Aurora × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a night pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS). Folder lists this as: Phenomenal Aurora. Part of the Space Station Remote Manipulator System (SSRMS) arm is also visible.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The station arm interrupts the aurora. Ambient music allows both the machinery and the light to remain present.

zh-CN.title: 极光与空间站机械臂
facts: 档案注明极光之外，还可见空间站遥操作机械臂的一部分。 NASA档案日期：2014-08-27；摄影：Reid Wiseman。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 空间站机械臂挡在极光前；氛围音乐让机械和光都留在这里。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-11-24
originalTitle: Earth Observations × Cylinder One

facts.text: Earth observation taken by the Expedition 42 crew aboard the ISS.
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder One, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: Only a narrow horizon separates blue from black; a compact ambient piece respects that economy.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-11-24
facts: 国际空间站第42远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-11-24，摄影者为Terry Virts；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder One，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 蓝与黑之间只剩一条窄地平线；短小的氛围配合这种简省。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-07-06
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Recuerdos de la Alhambra

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Carlo Alberto Boni performs Francisco Tárrega’s Recuerdos de la Alhambra on guitar in this recording.

note: Pale land folds around blue water; guitar gives the broad curves a more intimate scale.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-06
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-06，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
这份录音由Carlo Alberto Boni以吉他演奏弗朗西斯科·塔雷加《阿尔罕布拉宫的回忆》。
zh-CN.note: 浅色陆地围住蓝水；吉他把宽阔的曲线缩到较亲近的尺度。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-07-11
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Seven

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Seven, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: A dark landmass carries a thin sprinkling of cloud. Long-form ambience lets the dark area stay unfilled.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-11
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-11，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Seven，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 深色陆块上只有稀疏云点；长段氛围不急着把那片暗处填满。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-12
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Fresh Air

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Fresh Air with an upload date of 2015-12-21 and the instrumentation Piano.

note: The terrain is mottled rather than sharply divided; a piano-only selection supplies a simple foreground.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-12
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-06-12，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Fresh Air》的上传日期列为2015-12-21，配器列为钢琴。
zh-CN.note: 地形斑驳，没有清楚分区；只用钢琴，给眼前留一个简单的前景。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-29
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Cylinder Eight

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Cylinder Eight, released on Cylinders (2014).

note: The atmosphere fades gradually above the land; ambience suits an edge that cannot be traced exactly.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-29
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-06-29，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Cylinder Eight，收录于2014年的《Cylinders》。
zh-CN.note: 大气在陆地上方渐渐淡去；氛围适合这道无法准确描边的边缘。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-07-30
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Heliograph

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
Chris Zabriskie wrote, produced and performed Heliograph, released on Divider (2011).

note: A broad wash of reflected light almost erases the surface; Heliograph leaves that brightness as the subject.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-07-30
facts: 国际空间站第40远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-07-30，摄影者为Reid Wiseman；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Chris Zabriskie创作、制作并演奏Heliograph，收录于2011年的《Divider》。
zh-CN.note: 大片反光几乎擦掉地表；《Heliograph》让亮度本身成为观看对象。

title: Earth from orbit · 2014-06-22
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Kalimba Relaxation Music

facts.text: Earth Observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 40 crew aboard the International Space Station (ISS).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists Kalimba Relaxation Music with an upload date of 2019-12-19 and the instrumentation Kalimba, Synth.

note: Cloud dots are scattered across the terrain; kalimba and synth offer a small-scale counterpart to the pattern.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2014-06-22
facts: 国际空间站第40远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2014-06-22，摄影者为Reid Wiseman；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《Kalimba Relaxation Music》的上传日期列为2019-12-19，配器列为卡林巴、合成器。
zh-CN.note: 云点散落在地表上；卡林巴与合成器给这组点状纹理一个小尺度的回应。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-07-04
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Gymnopédie No. 3

facts.text: Earth observation taken during day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
David Hernando Vitores’s recording arranges Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 3 for soprano saxophone and strings.

note: Clouds skim the coastline; the saxophone-and-strings Satie arrangement keeps a single melodic presence beside them.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-07-04
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-07-04，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
David Hernando Vitores的这份录音将萨蒂《第三号吉姆诺佩蒂》改编为高音萨克斯与弦乐版本。
zh-CN.note: 云掠过海岸；萨克斯与弦乐版萨蒂，让旁边始终有一条旋律。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-13
originalTitle: Earth Observation × That Zen Moment

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

note: The frame is mostly ochre ground with a pale rim; the sparse instrumental palette keeps that weight of colour.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-13
facts: 国际空间站第36远征队拍摄的地球影像。NASA档案日期为2013-06-13，摄影者为Karen Nyberg；原始说明未提供确切地点。
Kevin MacLeod的官方目录将《That Zen Moment》的上传日期列为2024-04-14，配器列为弦乐、碗鼓。
zh-CN.note: 画面大半是赭色地表和浅色边沿；简省的器乐编制保留这块颜色的分量。

title: Earth from orbit · 2013-06-11
originalTitle: Earth Observation × Gnossienne No. 2

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by an Expedition 36 crew member on board the International Space Station (ISS).
La Pianista performs Satie’s Gnossienne No. 2 on piano in this recording.

note: Water divides two finely marked shores. Satie's piano is a deliberate contrast to the busy detail.

zh-CN.title: 从轨道看地球 · 2013-06-11

originalTitle: Géiseres del Tatio, Atacama, Chile, 2016-02-01, DD 36-38 HDR × That Zen Moment

facts.text: Close-up of a geyser in El Tatio, north of Chile, within the Andes Mountains near the Bolivian border. El Tatio is a geyser field at 4,320 meters above mean sea level and one of the highest-elevation geyser fields in the world. The field has over 80 active geysers, making it the largest geyser field in the southern hemisphere and the third largest in the world (after Yellowstone in the USA and Kronotsky Nature Reserve in Rusia).
Kevin MacLeod’s official catalog lists That Zen Moment with an upload date of 2024-04-14 and the instrumentation Strings, Bowl Drum.

title: 006 Dune 45 in Sossusvlei at sunrise Photo by Giles Laurent
originalTitle: 006 Dune 45 in Sossusvlei at sunrise Photo by Giles Laurent × Gymnopédie No. 1

facts.text: Dune 45 in Sossusvlei (Namibia) at sunrise. Dune 45 is composed of iron-rich quartz sand, whose deepening red tones result from the gradual oxidation of iron over millions of years. The sand grains originated from sediments carried by the Orange River into the Atlantic Ocean and transported northward by coastal currents before being blown inland by strong south-westerly winds. The Namib Desert itself is considered one of the oldest deserts on Earth—at least 5 million years old, and possibly…
This recording of Satie’s Gymnopédie No. 1 is credited to Teknopazzo, with file repair by Mitar, and released under CC0.

title: Above the Caspian
originalTitle: Clouds over the Caspian Sea × duduk-improvisation2

facts.text: Earth observation taken during a day pass by the Expedition 37 crew. Per Twitter message: intersecting clouds over the Caspian Sea & Caucasus Mountains.
SERGO.TEL released this duduk performance on April; the source dates the recording to 29 March 2010.

note: A breath instrument beside a view taken beyond the atmosphere: this pairing tests a change of scale, from one performer to the Earth. It is an editorial juxtaposition, not a claim that this recording comes from the place below.

zh-CN.title: 里海上空
facts: 档案引用的宇航员文字提到里海与高加索山脉上空交错的云。 NASA档案日期：2013-10-17；摄影：Karen Nyberg。
SERGO.TEL的这段duduk演奏收录于April；来源标注日期为2010年3月29日。
zh-CN.note: 把吹奏乐器放在大气层外的视角旁，试着让一个人的演奏与地球的尺度相遇。这是编选上的并置，不是说录音来自照片中的地方。

title: Dune and Breath
originalTitle: 006 Dune 45 in Sossusvlei at sunrise Photo by Giles Laurent × duduk-improvisation2

facts.text: Dune 45 in Sossusvlei (Namibia) at sunrise. Dune 45 is composed of iron-rich quartz sand, whose deepening red tones result from the gradual oxidation of iron over millions of years. The sand grains originated from sediments carried by the Orange River into the Atlantic Ocean and transported northward by coastal currents before being blown inland by strong south-westerly winds. The Namib Desert itself is considered one of the oldest deserts on Earth—at least 5 million years old, and possibly…
SERGO.TEL released this duduk performance on April; the source dates the recording to 29 March 2010.

note: The dune gives the eye one strong edge to follow. I chose a single named instrumental performance rather than a desert sound effect: the picture can remain a place, without asking the music to impersonate it.

zh-CN.title: 沙丘与呼吸
facts: 纳米比亚索苏斯弗雷的45号沙丘，摄于日出时分。
SERGO.TEL的这段duduk演奏收录于April；来源标注日期为2010年3月29日。
zh-CN.note: 沙丘给目光留下一道清楚的边缘。这里选择一段具体的器乐演奏，而不是沙漠音效，让照片保留自己的地点，不要求音乐扮演它。

title: Through the Bamboo
originalTitle: Sintel — bamboo forest × 流水

facts.text: David Revoy published this environment artwork in his Sintel art-direction gallery. The source identifies it as sintel — bamboo forest.
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: This bamboo forest was imagined for an animated journey. Pairing it with a documented guqin performance lets an invented environment meet a real performance tradition, without presenting the music as the film’s soundtrack.

zh-CN.title: 穿过竹林
facts: David Revoy在《Sintel》美术指导图集中发布了这件作品；页面将其说明为辛特尔旅途中的竹林预想图。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 这片竹林为动画中的旅途而构想。让它与一段有记录的古琴演奏相遇，是把虚构环境与真实演奏传统并置，并不把这段音乐说成电影原声。

title: Water, Left in Sand
originalTitle: Morro Jable (Fuerteventura, Spain), Strand -- 2025 -- 2487 × 流水

facts.text: Structures with different colored sand on the beach of Morro Jable, Fuerteventura, Spain
Charlie Huang recorded the Sichuan-style guqin piece Liu Shui in Birmingham on 15 April 2006.

note: The photograph records patterns in differently coloured sand, rather than a wide sea view. Flowing Water is a deliberate partner for those traces: a title-led connection to test while looking closely, not a claim of natural sound.

zh-CN.title: 水留在沙中
facts: 西班牙富埃特文图拉岛Morro Jable海滩上，不同颜色的沙粒形成纹理。
Charlie Huang于2006年4月15日在伯明翰录制这首川派古琴曲《流水》。
zh-CN.note: 照片拍的是不同颜色沙粒形成的纹理，而非宽阔海景。《流水》与这些痕迹的联系从题名出发，适合一边细看一边检验，不把琴声当成自然录音。

title: Snow and Bellows
originalTitle: Forest Snowfall × Largo · Concerto in D major, RV 93

facts.text: First Snowfall in the Forest
Paul De Bra recorded this accordion-orchestra arrangement of Vivaldi’s RV 93 Largo in 2020. The supplied file is the 2022 speed-adjusted version.

note: The source describes a first snowfall. An accordion arrangement offers a different material beside that image than the familiar piano choice. This experiment is about an unexpected instrumental setting, not an invented winter programme for Vivaldi.

zh-CN.title: 雪与风箱
facts: 作者将画面描述为森林中的第一场降雪。
Paul De Bra于2020年录制这版维瓦尔第RV 93广板的手风琴乐团改编；此文件为2022年调整速度的版本。
zh-CN.note: 作者描述的是第一场降雪。手风琴改编让这幅画面旁多了一种不同于惯常钢琴的材料；尝试的是乐器配置，不是替维瓦尔第虚构冬日主题。

title: A Largo at the Bay
originalTitle: Singapore city skyline at night 1 × Largo · Concerto in D major, RV 93

facts.text: A view of the skyline of the Central Business District of Singapore from The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands.
Paul De Bra recorded this accordion-orchestra arrangement of Vivaldi’s RV 93 Largo in 2020. The supplied file is the 2022 speed-adjusted version.

note: A Baroque movement, a contemporary accordion arrangement, and a Singapore night photograph belong to different moments. I put them together to leave the city outside the window while the recording supplies another pace.

zh-CN.title: 海湾广板
facts: 从滨海湾金沙购物中心望向新加坡中央商业区的天际线。
Paul De Bra于2020年录制这版维瓦尔第RV 93广板的手风琴乐团改编；此文件为2022年调整速度的版本。
zh-CN.note: 巴洛克乐章、当代手风琴改编和新加坡夜景属于不同的时间。将它们放在一起，是想把城市留在窗外，让录音提供另一种步速。

title: Petals in Clay
originalTitle: Wall Tile with Lotus Blossom × Eastern Thought

facts.text: Wall Tile with Lotus Blossom — c. 1300–50. Catalogue attribution: Iran, probably Sultanabad, Ilkhanid period (1256–1353).
The creator credits strings, metallic sounds and percussion in this contemporary instrumental.

note: The lotus tile gives the metallic percussion a small, tangible surface to inhabit. This is a contemporary scoring experiment beside an Iranian object, not a reconstruction of its historical sound.

zh-CN.title: 泥中的花瓣
facts: 莲花纹墙砖，约1300—1350年；馆方归为伊朗伊儿汗国时期，可能产自苏丹纳巴德。
作者为这首当代器乐列出的配器包括弦乐、金属音色与打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 莲花瓷砖让金属打击乐有了一小块可以落脚的表面。这是当代配乐与伊朗器物的相遇，不是历史声音的复原。

title: After the City
originalTitle: environments-14-Ishtar-ziggurat.jpg × Eastern Thought

facts.text: David Revoy published this environment artwork in his Sintel art-direction gallery. The source identifies it as ishtar — abandoned ziggurat.
The creator credits strings, metallic sounds and percussion in this contemporary instrumental.

note: An abandoned ziggurat invites a soundtrack, but not a battle scene. The strings and small percussion offer a measured way through the architecture; the recording's changes may suit drawing better than close reading.

zh-CN.title: 城去之后
facts: David Revoy在《Sintel》美术指导图集中发布了这件作品；页面将其说明为伊什塔尔废弃神塔的概念画。
作者为这首当代器乐列出的配器包括弦乐、金属音色与打击乐。
zh-CN.note: 废弃的塔庙可以有声音，却不必变成战场。弦乐和打击乐为建筑提供步速；曲中的变化也许更适合画图，而非逐字阅读。

title: Stone and Metal
originalTitle: Exteriors of Cave 22, Ellora Caves, Maharashtra, India 01.jpg × Eastern Thought
