note: The long exposure makes the water soft while the rocks keep their weight. The piano-and-marimba setting gives us similarly distinct points inside a broader atmosphere; neither needs to follow the other literally.

zh-CN.title: 给潮水留地方
facts: 澳大利亚维多利亚州Peterborough附近、坎贝尔港国家公园内的Worm Bay。
Buckley将2020年发布的《Solace》描述为以弦乐、合成器陪衬钢琴与玻璃马林巴的平静作品。
Scott Buckley是常驻布里斯班的澳大利亚作曲者与编曲者，其创作结合管弦写作与电子声音。
zh-CN.note: 长曝光把水变得柔软，岩石却仍有重量。钢琴和马林巴也可以在宽阔氛围中提供清楚的落点，不必让声音逐一模仿画面。

title: Under the Dome
originalTitle: State Library Victoria, La Trobe Reading Room Dome × In This Moment

facts.text: State Library Victoria, La Trobe Reading Room Dome
In This Moment is Buckley’s 2026 work for intimate solo piano.
Scott Buckley is an Australian composer and arranger based in Brisbane, combining orchestral writing with electronic textures.

note: The dome is monumental; the music is deliberately small. That difference is the reason to pair them: even in a large public room, your work can remain a private, manageable thing.

zh-CN.title: 穹顶之下
facts: 澳大利亚维多利亚州立图书馆拉筹伯阅览室的穹顶。
《In This Moment》是Buckley于2026年发布的近距离感独奏钢琴作品。
Scott Buckley是常驻布里斯班的澳大利亚作曲者与编曲者，其创作结合管弦写作与电子声音。
zh-CN.note: 穹顶很宏大，音乐却刻意选得小。正因为这个差别才把它们放在一起：即使身处宽阔的公共空间，手上的工作也可以是私人的、做得过来的事。

title: Beyond the Footbridge
originalTitle: Footbridge over a pond in Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden and NTT DoCoMo Yoyogi Building, Tokyo, Japan × Minamo

facts.text: Footbridge over a pond in Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden and NTT DoCoMo Yoyogi Building in the background, a sunny day with blue sky, Tokyo, Japan.
Minamo was published in 2016 as a relaxed Japanese-style piano piece at 85 BPM; the listed instrumentation includes koto and glass marimba.
PeriTune is Sei Mutsuki’s project, founded in 2015 after work in independent music circles.

note: Shinjuku’s tower stays in view behind the garden. A contemporary Japanese game-music creator belongs beside that mixture of garden and city; there is no need to make the scene look timeless.

zh-CN.title: 小桥那边
facts: 日本东京新宿御苑的池塘小桥，背景中可见NTT DoCoMo代代木大厦。
《Minamo》于2016年发布，作者说明为85 BPM的舒缓和风钢琴曲，列出的配器包含琴与玻璃马林巴。
PeriTune由むつき醒（Sei Mutsuki）在同人音乐活动之后于2015年创立。
zh-CN.note: 新宿的高楼留在园林后方。当代日本游戏音乐创作者的作品，正适合这个园林与城市并存的画面，不必把它装扮成没有年代的古景。

title: Between Two Rocks
originalTitle: Takado Coast 01 × Quiet_Ocean

facts.text: This is a landscape of Takado coast in Takahagi, Ibaraki, Japan.
Quiet_Ocean was published in 2023 as ocean-themed ambient music. This edition uses the creator’s no-percussion MP3 variant.
PeriTune is Sei Mutsuki’s project, founded in 2015 after work in independent music circles.

note: The gap between the rocks matters as much as the rocks themselves. Choosing the no-percussion version keeps that open space in the foreground; the real coast and the imagined sea need not be identical.

zh-CN.title: 两块岩石之间
facts: 日本茨城县高萩市的高户海岸景观。
《Quiet_Ocean》于2023年发布，是海洋意象的氛围作品；这里使用作者提供的无打击乐MP3版本。
PeriTune由むつき醒（Sei Mutsuki）在同人音乐活动之后于2015年创立。
zh-CN.note: 两块岩石之间的空处，与岩石本身一样重要。选择无打击乐版本，是想把这段空处留下来；真实海岸与想象中的海不必完全一致。

title: Before the Next Step
originalTitle: Boat with autumny mountains at Digermulen, Hinnøya, Norway, Norway, 2015 September × Autumn Walk

facts.text: A small boat at Digermulen port, Hinnøya, Norway in 2015 September. The mountains Litlkorsnestinden and Korsnestinden in the background are located on island Austvågøya.
Autumn Walk is listed by Nakarada as an 88 BPM fantasy, Celtic-influenced ambient piece with a relaxed mood.
Alexander Nakarada is a Norwegian composer whose catalogue includes contemporary fantasy, folk-influenced and retro game music.

note: The little boat is motionless beneath the autumn mountains. A walking piece beside a resting boat makes a useful pause: movement can be present without requiring you to go anywhere.

zh-CN.title: 下一步之前
facts: 挪威Digermulen港口的一艘小船，背景山峰位于Austvågøya岛。
Nakarada将《Autumn Walk》标注为88 BPM、带凯尔特影响的奇幻氛围作品，情绪标签包含relaxed。
Alexander Nakarada是一位挪威作曲者，其作品包含当代奇幻、民谣影响与复古游戏音乐。
zh-CN.note: 小船停在秋色的山下。用一首关于行走的作品配一艘休息的船，是想留下一个停顿：可以有行进感，但不用急着去哪里。

title: Upstairs
originalTitle: Sintel bedroom — first concept × 8-bit Tavern

facts.text: David Revoy published this environment artwork in his Sintel art-direction gallery. The source identifies it as sintel bedroom — first concept.
8-bit Tavern is Nakarada’s 75 BPM retro-game ambient piece, labelled relaxed on the creator’s own page.
Alexander Nakarada is a Norwegian composer whose catalogue includes contemporary fantasy, folk-influenced and retro game music.

note: Revoy’s overhead room study makes every piece of furniture feel reachable. A restrained retro game setting turns the view into a familiar stopping place, rather than a scene waiting for combat to start.

zh-CN.title: 楼上
facts: David Revoy在《Sintel》美术指导图集中发布了这件作品；页面将其说明为辛特尔卧室的初步概念画。
《8-bit Tavern》是Nakarada的75 BPM复古游戏氛围作品，作者页面的情绪标签包含relaxed。
Alexander Nakarada是一位挪威作曲者，其作品包含当代奇幻、民谣影响与复古游戏音乐。
zh-CN.note: Revoy从上方画房间，家具都像伸手就能碰到。克制的复古游戏声音，让这里成为熟悉的落脚点，而不是等战斗开始的场景。
